module.purpose: Defines the store schema model, serialized schema formats, record validation, migration planning, persistence migration, and schema serialization for the store subsystem.
module.summary: This module provides the central schema authority for typed records and migration sequences. It supports legacy and current serialized schema formats, upgrades legacy schemas, validates records with optional recovery callbacks, caches migration plans, migrates individual records or complete storage backends, removes non-document records during storage migration, and exposes current or earliest schema versions. The main class coordinates record definitions, migration ordering, integrity-checker setup, and persistence-facing schema operations.
module.businessContext: Supports versioned persistence for collaborative document stores and protects data across application upgrades. Failures can prevent stored documents from loading, migrate records incorrectly, or leave storage inconsistent.
